known_risks: 中文：强制 JP v96 中回避距离效果 ID 的全部直接检查；它只改变回避位移，不增加 #48 的无敌帧。请使用固定武器、起点和方向，对比一次完整翻滚的终点。 / English: Forces every direct JP-v96 check for the Evade Extender effect ID; it changes dodge displacement only and does not add the invulnerability frames from #48. Use a fixed weapon, starting point, and direction, then compare the endpoint of one complete roll.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #21“回避距离 UP”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #21 "Evade Extender" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
